anomalies.label: CLUSTER J1419-A
anomalies.subtitle: Gravitational Lens // Suspected Horizon Arc
anomalies.description: Foreground elliptical cluster bending a background spiral into a near-complete Einstein ring. Sweep into near-infrared (~1340nm) and zoom in to inspect the anomalous geometric seam.

anomalies.label: DEEP FIELD S-04
anomalies.subtitle: Particle-Horizon Repeating Facet
anomalies.description: Ultra-deep spiral field far beneath Sol-Centauri's dust glare. At ~1560nm, faint angular regularity repeats at the same curvature radius as J1419-A.

anomalies.label: SOL–CENTAURI BEARING
anomalies.subtitle: Home Reference // 10.0 Light-Years
anomalies.description: Optical reference bearing back toward Sol and Alpha Centauri (4.37 ly apart, 10.0 ly astern). Proves the horizon seams are offset 10 ly onto humanity—not centered on this probe.
